title: Fourier coefficient of a singleton indicator
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $S$ be any subset of the coordinates of the $n$-dimensional binary cube. The Fourier coefficient at $S$ of the indicator function of the zero vector is $2^{-n}$.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a finite set of coordinates
